description: This file defines the Vtiger_MailScannerRule class, which manages email scanning rules including criteria matching, actions, and database interactions within the MailScanner module of vtiger CRM.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerRule
classes.description: Represents a mail scanning rule with criteria, actions, and database persistence methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule object with data from the database based on rule ID.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the rule's criteria.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads rule data from the database for the given rule ID.

methods.name: initializeActions
methods.description: Loads associated actions for the rule from the database.

methods.name: hasBodyRule
methods.description: Checks if the rule has a body condition.

methods.name: isMatching
methods.description: Determines if two match results satisfy the rule's match criteria (AND/OR).

methods.name: applyAll
methods.description: Applies all rule criteria to a mail record to determine if it matches.

methods.name: hasACondition
methods.description: Checks if the rule has any condition set.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a specific subrule condition to a mail record.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Checks if a mail record field matches a condition against a search string.

methods.name: __CreateMatchResult
methods.description: Creates a match result array for a subrule.

methods.name: __CreateDefaultMatchResult
methods.description: Creates a default match result based on match criteria.

methods.name: hasRegexMatch
methods.description: Checks if a match result contains a regex match.

methods.name: resetSequence
methods.description: Swaps the sequence order of two rules in the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or inserts the rule into the database.

methods.name: __nextsequence
methods.description: Retrieves the next sequence number for rule ordering.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the rule and its associated actions from the database.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Updates or deletes the associated action for the rule.

methods.name: takeAction
methods.description: Executes the associated action on a mail record if the rule matches.
